reason: I don't want my clients' tone docs and content sitting in a tool I've never heard of, and it doesn't even publish or handle approvals, which is where my week actually goes. I'd have to copy everything into my scheduler anyway, so it's one more subscription to cancel in a month.
objection: Client data in an unknown tool, and it doesn't do the approvals over WhatsApp/email that eat my time. Another 19 euros a month when I already use a free chatbot.
would_change_my_mind: Client approvals built in and a clear, credible statement of how client data is stored and not used for training, plus a trial long enough to test it on a real client for a few weeks.
